name: Marginals
description: The Marginals were a New York street gang active in Greenwich Village and along the Hudson River waterfront during the early 1900s. Founded and led by stevedore Thomas F. 'Tanner' Smith, the gang battled the Hudson Dusters for control of the Lower West Side territory, eventually succeeding them. They were involved in extortion and labor slugging. Their reign ended when Smith was murdered on July 26, 1919.
